|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E1 of [[Guild Of Assassins (V)]]; it is the current text. No published image shows this text, so the image here is a CardMaker recreation of it ([[:File:VB6-09-Guild_Of_Assassins-PC-E1-cardmaker.png]], made 9 November 2026). The Virtual Block 6.3 release-sheet slip and the Players Committee card image show the original text; see [[Guild Of Assassins (V)]].
* '''Original''' ([[Guild Of Assassins (V)]]): text as given in the Virtual Block 6.3 release sheet (official text as of 15 March 2010; the surviving copy was re-made 4 April 2010): “Deploy on table. Maul is lost. Once per character, when you deploy Aurra, Galen, Guri, or Mara to a Coruscant or Tatooine site, may take any one card from Used Pile into hand; reshuffle. At locations you occupy, your Force generation may not be prevented or canceled. [Immune to Alter]”.<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock6_3">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock6_3.pdf Virtual Block 6.3 release sheet] ("Official text as of 15 March 2010"; surviving copy re-made 4 April 2010). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261022213441/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock6_3.pdf Internet Archive]</ref> The Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013) prints this text again (Dark Side, p. 26). That copy is a stale reprint, not a new version, because the PC website card list already showed the later text of [[Guild Of Assassins (V) (Errata)]] (wiki versions ruling, 8 November 2026).<ref name="ml-ds">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): The PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and still on 11 January 2013) spells “Aurra” as “Aura” (the list appends the concept credit “(Original concept by Aaron Nelson - Western Nationals 2009)” to the text, as it does for other cards; that credit line is not game text): “Deploy on table. Maul is lost. Once per character, when you deploy Aura, Galen, Guri, or Mara to a Coruscant or Tatooine site, may take any one card from Used Pile into hand; reshuffle. At locations you occupy, your Force generation may not be prevented or canceled. (Immune to Alter.)”.<ref name="cl-1263_9-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock6Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064737/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock6Type.html 2012-07-21], [https://web.archive.org/web/20121212001607/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock6Type.html 2012-12-12] and [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111142254/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock6Type.html 2013-01-11] (Internet Archive); the Virtual master list (VMasterType) shows the same text from 2012-07-21 to 2013-01-11</ref>
